# Hollowbrook Roasters

> Hollowbrook Roasters is a small-batch coffee roaster and café in West Asheville, North Carolina. Single-origin coffees, a flexible subscription, and wholesale for cafés.

## Shop

- [Home](https://hollowbrookroasters.com/): Who we are, how we roast and ship, and where to start.
- [Coffees](https://hollowbrookroasters.com/coffees.html): Single-origin coffees from Ethiopia, Colombia, Guatemala, Kenya and Sumatra, plus our house blend and a sugarcane decaf. Roasted to order in Asheville, NC.
- [Subscription](https://hollowbrookroasters.com/subscription.html): Fresh-roasted 12 oz bags every one, two or four weeks for $19 a bag, shipping included. Skip, pause or cancel any time.
- [Wholesale](https://hollowbrookroasters.com/wholesale.html): Wholesale coffee for cafés, restaurants and offices in Western North Carolina and beyond, with barista training and equipment support.
- [Wholesale for cafés](https://hollowbrookroasters.com/solutions/cafes.html): Espresso and drip coffee for independent cafés, with barista training, dial-in help and twice-weekly delivery around Asheville.
- [Wholesale for restaurants](https://hollowbrookroasters.com/solutions/restaurants.html): Coffee chosen to suit your menu, staff training and twice-weekly delivery around Asheville.
- [Wholesale for offices](https://hollowbrookroasters.com/solutions/offices.html): Fresh small-batch coffee for offices, delivered on roast days, with brewing and equipment advice.

## Brew guides

- [Brew guides](https://hollowbrookroasters.com/brew-guides/): Simple, tested recipes for brewing Hollowbrook coffee at home: V60 pour-over and cold brew concentrate, with ratios, grind sizes and timings.
- [A three-minute V60 pour-over](https://hollowbrookroasters.com/brew-guides/v60-pour-over.html): Our everyday V60 pour-over recipe: 22 g of coffee to 360 g of water, four pours, about three minutes. Grind size, temperature and troubleshooting.
- [Cold brew concentrate](https://hollowbrookroasters.com/brew-guides/cold-brew.html): How to make cold brew concentrate at home: a 1:5 ratio steeped for 16 hours in the fridge, then diluted 1:1. Which coffees work best and how long it keeps.

## Visit and contact

- [Visit the café](https://hollowbrookroasters.com/cafe.html): Hours, address and parking for the café and roastery on Haywood Road in West Asheville, NC.
- [About](https://hollowbrookroasters.com/about.html): Hollowbrook Roasters was founded in 2016 by Dana Whitlock and Eli Navarro. We roast small batches in West Asheville and buy green coffee from farms we know by name.
- [Contact](https://hollowbrookroasters.com/contact.html): How to reach us about an order, a subscription or wholesale.
